input.question: How much have firearms changed over the last seventy years?
input.ground_truth: Modern weapons are more ergonomic, reliable, and accurate due to improved manufacturing techniques. They are lighter and produce less recoil. A lot of this improvement has come in the last 20 years. You would probably have more luck posting this in a firearm-oriented sub like /r/guns.

Okay, let’s imagine you have a toy gun from seventy years ago and a toy gun today.

Seventy years ago, most guns were big and heavy. They needed special people to use them, and they didn’t have many safety features. They could only shoot a few times before you had to reload, and the bullets weren’t very accurate.

Now, today’s guns can be bigger or smaller, and some are even made of plastic. Some guns can shoot many times without stopping to reload. They have safety switches to help prevent accidents. Also, people use guns for different reasons now—some for police work, some for sports, and some for keeping people safe.

So, in seventy years, guns have gotten safer in some ways, smaller in some ways, and can do more things. But they are still very powerful and can be dangerous.
